visual_argument: One illustrative engine and its record, drawn as metal. The deck moves from the whole machine to the holes in its flight record, the record repaired at 37 of every 100 and shrunk, the 480 hour inspection as a length, the one blade the validator flags, the part a person pulls to a tray, the Lubbock to Fort Worth route, and back to the machine at an open hangar door with the two tools beside it, still on test.
build_risk: Frame 3 must make 37 gold cubes in a 100 socket machined tray countable at 432 px under an orthographic raking camera, reading as restored record cells and not as a waffle chart.
distinct_from_recent: Nov 25 drew glass lungs, manila folders and card files. Nov 24 drew an aerial subdivision and plate racks. Nov 22 drew cutaway exam rooms and studio benches. Nov 21 drew a tracked rover on rubble. None drew a turbine engine, a flight record tape, a machined socket tray, a turbine disc, an hour rule or a hangar door.
